title: hypericum longistylum subsp. giraldii
intro: Hypericum longistylum subsp. giraldii, commonly known as the Giraldo's St. John's Wort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the St. John's Wort family, Hypericaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, depression, and insomnia due to its health benefits, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum longistylum subsp. giraldii are attributed to its ability to modulate neurotransmitter levels, promoting a balanced mood and reducing stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include naphthodianthrones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
